exec: pm.test("Paginated summaries", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(json.meta.per_page).to.eql(20); json.data.forEach(row => pm.expect(row).not.to.have.property("items")); });

item.name: Inventory
item.description: Only RAW_MATERIAL and PURCHASED_PRODUCT have physical stock. Set product_id to an existing stocked product. Manual examples use PURCHASE IN; WASTE requires OUT and ADJUSTMENT allows either.

exec: pm.test("Physical stock with decimal strings", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(row => { pm.expect(["RAW_MATERIAL", "PURCHASED_PRODUCT"]).to.include(row.item_type); pm.expect(row.current_quantity).to.match(/^\d+\.\d{3}$/); }));

item.name: Print Jobs
item.description: Listing captures a failed job ID when available. Retry uses its stored payload. NETWORK attempts can result in PRINTED or FAILED; local transports requeue as PENDING.

exec: pm.test("Paginated jobs", () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(json).to.have.property("meta"); });

const failed = pm.response.json().data.find(job => job.status === "FAILED"); if (failed) { pm.collectionVariables.set("print_job_id", failed.id); pm.collectionVariables.set("print_job_attempts", failed.attempts); }

pm.test("Pagination metadata", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("links"); pm.expect(j.meta.current_page).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(j.meta.per_page).to.be.within(1, 100); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.be.a("number"); });

pm.test("Accurate retry result", () => { const job = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(["PENDING", "PRINTED", "FAILED"]).to.include(job.status); pm.expect(job.attempts).to.be.a("number"); if (job.status === "PRINTED") pm.expect(job.printed_at).not.to.eql(null); else pm.expect(job.printed_at).to.eql(null); const previous = pm.variables.get("print_job_attempts"); if (previous !== undefined && previous !== "") pm.expect(job.attempts).to.eql(Number(previous) + (job.status === "PENDING" ? 0 : 1)); });

pm.test("Dashboard sections", () => { const data = pm.response.json().data; ["period", "sales", "expenses", "net_cash_flow", "orders", "tables", "top_products", "recent_active_orders"].forEach(key => pm.expect(data).to.have.property(key)); pm.expect(data.top_products.length).to.be.at.most(5); pm.expect(data.recent_active_orders.length).to.be.at.most(10); });

pm.test("Financial period and daily rows", () => { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.period.from).to.eql(pm.variables.get("report_from")); pm.expect(data.period.to).to.eql(pm.variables.get("report_to")); pm.expect(data.breakdown).to.be.an("array"); ["sales", "expenses", "net_cash_flow"].forEach(key => pm.expect(data[key]).to.match(/^-?\d+\.\d{2}$/)); });

pm.test("Top products", () => { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(data.length).to.be.at.most(10); data.forEach(row => { pm.expect(row.quantity_sold).to.match(/^\d+\.\d{2}$/); pm.expect(row.sales_amount).to.match(/^\d+\.\d{2}$/); }); });

pm.test("Pagination metadata", () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(j).to.have.property("links"); pm.expect(j.meta.current_page).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(j.meta.per_page).to.be.within(1, 100); pm.expect(j.meta.total).to.be.a("number"); });
